name: u29-add-field-index-1m
about: Add a field, then a declared index on it, to a kind with 1,038,409 records (the founder's execution kind [S o03], 777 B typical size [S o26]); reads of that kind continue daily. Declaring is a model change over existing records (extended intent `declare`). Rate: once (plan); reads 50/day. Sources: [A] 04-every-table-challenged.md; [P] clone queries on o08/o21/o27/o04/o07/o09 (profile-overhead lane, 2026-10-27); [L] clone queries o03 record_log 2026-10-20..22 PDT, o04 namespace_names, o21 account_control_permits operations (4 load days 2026-10-15..23); [S] --seed-from profile: founder o03 2,398,695 current records / 178 kinds, second account o26 24,263 records. Typical sizes come from the second account [S o26] where the kind exists there, else the founder [S o03].
